item.description: Moldova’s Russia-friendly Gagauzia region voted today amid longstanding tensions over EU integration. Independent Alexandr Stoianoglo, who favors ties with Moscow while supporting EU membership, is leading early w/ 37.3% over the “pro-Russian” candidate at 26.6%. - MOLDPRES
item.content:encoded:

item.description: Trump, Xi and Putin plan a first ever trilateral meeting Thursday in Shenzhen on the APEC sidelines. They have agreed to meet on nuclear arms reduction and Iran. The White House confirmed Friday, the Kremlin confirmed yesterday.
item.content:encoded:
